mostWorthwhile.text: Following glucose into storage and back into the blood made the liver's role between meals easy to understand.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the vein was straightforward but less interesting on its own; it gave little explanation beyond the fitting.

surprise.text: The liver can join glucose into a store and break it down again when food isn't coming in.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary: the vein fitting was an obvious named slot, although it was the only available combination.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how other organs connect to the body, though I'd hope for more explanation than the final fitting provided.
